requirements.statement: Each short (inline) quotation uses a <q> element.

citations.quote: Dans chaque page web, chaque citation courte utilise-t-elle une balise `<q>` ?
Retrouver dans le document les citations courtes (ou en ligne) ;

routes.statement: The quotation is structured with a <q> element.

citations.quote: Pour chaque citation, vérifier que la citation est structurée au moyen d’un élément `<q>` ;

rationale.text: The test applies to each short quotation, and finding quotations is judgment: no glossary entry defines one, and whether a passage repeats someone else's words depends on its meaning. One route is accepted, a <q> element. Code can see <q> elements, but not the quotations that lack one, so no check can show that every quotation uses it, and no element is surely a quotation without markup. A check flagging text between quotation marks was considered and not registered: quotation marks also enclose titles, terms and irony, and a quotation may have none, so its result would carry little evidence either way. No axe rule is tagged for this test. The wording asks only that quotations use <q>; whether <q> is used for something that is not a quotation is outside it. The candidate is none, with no link. Applicability is judgment, because whether the page holds a short quotation cannot be decided by code. Needs is empty.

citations.quote: Dans chaque page web, chaque citation est-elle correctement indiquée ?
Si c’est le cas pour chaque citation courte, **le test est validé**.
